fp2_long_run_median_pace.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 consecutive green-flag timed laps in FP2.
fp2_long_run_median_pace.missing_handling: Set to null (None) if laps < 5 or on Sprint weekends where FP2 does not exist.

fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.formula: fp2_long_run_median_pace - median(fp2_long_run_median_pace of all valid starters)
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 valid starters with clean FP2 stints.
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.missing_handling: Set to null (None) if driver has no FP2 pace or on sprint weekends.
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.provenance: Derived from FastF1 FP2 stint telemetry.

fp2_stint_consistency.missing_handling: Set to null (None) if laps < 5 or on sprint weekends.

fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.sample_requirements: Minimum 6 clean laps in primary stint.
fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.missing_handling: Set to null (None) if laps < 6 or on sprint weekends.

qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.sample_requirements: Valid timed lap recorded in Q1, Q2, or Q3.
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.missing_handling: Set to null (None) for drivers without timed lap (crashed on out-lap).
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.prediction_cutoff: Cutoff 1 / Cutoff 2 / Cutoff S2 / Cutoff S3.

sector_pace_delta.sample_requirements: Valid sector splits in qualifying session.
sector_pace_delta.missing_handling: Set to null (None) if sector splits are unavailable.

sprint_race_pace_indicator.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 green-flag laps in Saturday 100km sprint race.
sprint_race_pace_indicator.missing_handling: Set to null (None) on standard format weekends (18 of 24 races).
sprint_race_pace_indicator.prediction_cutoff: Cutoff S2 (Post-Sprint GP Qualifying) / Cutoff S3 (Sprint Official Grid).
sprint_race_pace_indicator.provenance: FastF1 / Ergast Saturday Sprint Race classification and lap chart.

track_overtaking_difficulty.missing_handling: Defaults to 0.50 for unmapped new circuits.
track_overtaking_difficulty.provenance: Historical F1 overtaking database and FIA circuit layout registry.
